frequency_evidence.evidence: GoPro 60 FPS; AllTact tactile 30 FPS; synchronized observations.
16 sampled 7-frame tactile chunks: exactly 3/6 within-chunk adjacent pairs equal pixel-for-pixel. Camera chunks contain no duplicate frames. This supports the visual 60 Hz export grid.

notes: RGB intensity is not normal force. No grayscale conversion is used as a pressure label.
Missing chunks are invalid data, not observed zero contact.
All original numeric and identity fields are preserved; only calibrated fields may be mapped to model supervision.

60 Hz is the inferred nominal export grid, supported by 30 Hz tactile images duplicated pairwise and the documented 60 Hz visual stream. Original per-frame physical timestamps were discarded by FTP export.
